# AINews — Global Frontier Artificial Intelligence & Tech Journal

> Independent daily digital journalism covering breaking artificial intelligence news, frontier reasoning models, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, humanoid robotics, and silicon architectures.

- [Website](https://ainews.krishnavibez.in/): Live global news wire, technical analyses, and silicon benchmarks.
- [RSS Feed](https://ainews.krishnavibez.in/rss.xml): Syndicated feed for AI and feed aggregators.
- [Lead Editor & Author: Paresh Padsala](https://ainews.krishnavibez.in/authors/paresh-padsala.html): Principal editor, AI researcher, and technical journalist.
- [Editorial Ethics & Fact-Checking](https://ainews.krishnavibez.in/ethics.html): Strict editorial independence and verification standards.
- [Contact & Newsroom](https://ainews.krishnavibez.in/contact.html): Editorial inquiries and tip line.

## Key Subject Matter & Core Focus
- Frontier LLMs & Test-Time Compute (OpenAI o1/o3, Gemini 2.0, DeepSeek-R1, Claude 3.5)
- Autonomous Software Engineering & Computer-Use Agents
- Embodied Intelligence & Humanoid Robotics (Figure 02, Boston Dynamics Atlas, Unitree)
- Silicon Hardware & Semiconductor Physics (Nvidia Blackwell B200, TSMC N2, Wafer-Scale AI)

## In-Depth Articles & Technical Benchmarks
- [OpenAI Unveils o3: The First AI Model Capable of Multi-Day Autonomous Reasoning](https://ainews.krishnavibez.in/articles/openai-o3-reasoning-breakthrough-system-2-thinking.html):
  Detailed exploration of System 2 search, ARC-AGI 87.5% milestone, test-time compute economics, self-correction traces, and real-world deployment challenges.
